tasks_completed.description: Enabled horizontal scroll indicator on BashView ScrollView
tasks_completed.changes: Changed showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} to showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={true} on line 64
tasks_completed.rationale: Scrollbar was explicitly disabled, preventing users from seeing overflowing bash output

tasks_completed.description: Removed redundant borderBottomLeftRadius, borderBottomRightRadius, and overflow:hidden from BashView container styles
tasks_completed.changes: Removed borderBottomLeftRadius:11, borderBottomRightRadius:11, and overflow:'hidden' from styles.container (lines 90-92)
tasks_completed.rationale: Parent ToolView.container already has borderRadius:8 + overflow:hidden which clips all child content. BashView's negative margins align it with ToolView's edges, so ToolView's overflow:hidden naturally rounds the bottom corners. BashView's own overflow:hidden was redundant and clipped the horizontal scrollbar.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: a529bf91 - baseline state with border-radius + overflow:hidden + scrollbar disabled
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: BashView had its own borderBottomLeftRadius:11 + overflow:hidden to round bottom corners, but overflow:hidden also clips the ScrollView's horizontal scrollbar. Two prior fix attempts (79c915b2, 7216dd70) failed to identify that ToolView.container already provides the corner clipping.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Remove BashView's redundant overflow:hidden and borderRadius, relying on parent ToolView.container's borderRadius:8 + overflow:hidden for corner clipping. Enable scrollbar visibility on the ScrollView.

dev.tdd_skip_reason: Pure CSS/styling change - scrollbar visibility and border-radius are visual properties that cannot be programmatically tested. Requires Playwright visual verification.
dev.qa_notes: Verify with Playwright on dev.life-ai.app: (1) Find a bash tool call with wide output, confirm horizontal scrollbar is visible and functional. (2) Confirm bottom corners of tool card appear rounded (8px from ToolView). (3) Verify no scrollbar/text overlap with +N more lines indicator. (4) Test on both desktop (1280x720+) and mobile (390x844) viewports. Both _all.tsx and SidebarContentRenderer.tsx import BashView - check both contexts render correctly.
